Worktrees (already checked out, do not re-clone/checkout):
- HEAD (PR tip): /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-marcel-a-n-navarro-Dev-zimmermann-pwa/37973080-8be5-46e1-9aab-e2abcb81ea17/scratchpad/pr81-head

Already settled: tsc clean, vitest all green both sides, lint debt pre-existing/unrelated. Don't re-run these.

YOUR LANE: whether `zimmColourSwatch`/`zimmColourSwatchGroup`'s new `circle` variant / `appendColon` prop are genuinely additive (zero behavior change for the existing square/PDP path), and whether the new gallery overlay's "Also available in" colour set construction actually matches what the main PDP's own "Colour:" group construction does, as the PR claims. Other agents cover general styling conventions, React-logic correctness, security/a11y, and DRY/test-coverage — stay out of those, focus on contract fidelity specifically.

Do this by DIFFING base vs head yourself (don't trust my summary) for:
- `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmColourSwatch/index.tsx` and `zimmColourSwatch.css.ts`
- `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmColourSwatchGroup/index.tsx` and `zimmColourSwatchGroup.css.ts`
- `overrides/app/components/product-view/index.tsx` (look at where it builds `naturalColourValues`/`relatedColourValues`/`colourValues`)
- `overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.tsx` (look at the `renderVariationAttribute` callback where it builds `values`/`relatedSwatches`/`allValues` for `ZimmColourSwatchGroup`)

Specific things to verify — treat each as a lead, confirm or refute independently:

1. **Is the circle-variant/appendColon work purely additive?** For every prop added (`variant` on both ZimmColourSwatch and ZimmColourSwatchGroup, `appendColon` on ZimmColourSwatchGroup), confirm the default value reproduces the OLD (pre-PR) unconditional behavior byte-for-byte when the new prop is omitted — i.e. an existing caller that never passes `variant`/`appendColon` must render identically before and after this PR. Pay close attention to `zimmColourSwatchGroup/index.tsx`'s diff: I noticed the diff also adds `boxSize="var(--zimm-scale-m)"` to the `<ChevronLeftIcon>`/`<ChevronRightIcon>` — those icons had NO boxSize prop at all before this PR. That's a real rendered-size change to the EXISTING pagination-chevron icons on the already-shipping main PDP colour picker, riding along with the "purely additive" variant/appendColon work — it is not gated behind `variant === 'circle'`, it applies unconditionally to both variants. Confirm this precisely (exact before/after diff lines), and assess: is this acknowledged anywhere (commit message, code comment) as a deliberate bug fix, or does it look like unflagged scope creep bundled into an "additive" change? Either way, report it factually — don't assume malice or that it's necessarily wrong, just that it's a real behavioral change to existing shipped UI that the "purely additive" framing doesn't own up to.

2. **Does `ZimmColourSwatchGroup`'s square-variant CSS (zimmColourSwatchGroup.css.ts) actually compute to the identical values it did before, for every part, when `variant` defaults to `'square'`?** The file was restructured (GROUP_RESERVED_WIDTH split into SQUARE_RESERVED_WIDTH/CIRCLE_RESERVED_WIDTH, a new `SWATCH_GAP` variable). Trace the actual resolved value for `root.maxWidth`, `swatches.width`, `swatches.gap` in the square/default case, base vs head, and confirm they're identical.

3. **The `offered` colour-filter predicate.** `zimmColourSwatchGroup/index.tsx` has (unchanged by this PR) `values.filter((v) => Boolean(v.imageUrl) && v.orderable !== false)`. The new `zimmGalleryOverlay/index.tsx` independently re-writes the exact same predicate as `(colourValues ?? []).filter((v) => Boolean(v.imageUrl) && v.orderable !== false).length` to compute `offeredColourCount`. Confirm this is byte-identical duplicated logic (not just similar), confirm there's no shared exported predicate either component could have used instead (check `zimmColourSwatchGroupShared.ts`, which currently only exports `SWATCHES_PER_PAGE`), and note this as a DRY finding (a shared `isOfferedColour`-type predicate belongs in that shared module, same precedent as `SWATCHES_PER_PAGE`).

4. **The "matches product-detail's construction exactly" claim (SFCC-731 AC15 / SFCC-708).** Compare, field-by-field, how `product-view/index.tsx` builds `naturalColourValues` (from `colourAttr.values`) + `relatedColourValues` (via `buildRelatedSwatches`) + `colourValues = [...naturalColourValues, ...relatedColourValues]`, against how `product-detail/index.tsx`'s `renderVariationAttribute` callback builds its own `values` (from `attr.values`) + `relatedSwatches` (via the same `buildRelatedSwatches`) + `allValues = [...values, ...relatedSwatches]`. Check every field mapping: `value`, `name`, `imageUrl`, `href`, `orderable`. I noticed the `name` field differs: product-detail does `v.name ?? v.value ?? ''` (falls back if name is missing/empty) while product-view does `v.name` with no fallback at all — meaning if a variation value's `name` is ever undefined/empty, product-view would pass `name: undefined` into a field the `ZimmColourSwatchValue` type declares as required `string`, and that flows into `ZimmColourSwatch`'s `aria-label={name}` — an undefined aria-label attribute renders as no accessible name at all for that swatch. Confirm this discrepancy precisely (exact lines both sides), and assess how likely it is to matter in practice (is there any realistic SFCC scenario where a colour variation value lacks a `name`? related-swatch mapping via `buildRelatedSwatches` vs. natural variation values may differ here — check `RelatedSwatch`'s own shape/mapping too, in `pages/product-detail/productInfo.ts`, to see if related (SFCC-708) swatches are more or less likely to have this gap than natural ones). Also check `imageUrl` and `href`'s handling for the same kind of divergence (product-view defaults `imageUrl` to `''` when missing, product-detail leaves it `undefined` — functionally equivalent for the `Boolean(v.imageUrl)` filter check downstream, confirm that's true and not a false-equivalence).

5. **Test coverage for the new variant.** Does any test file (zimmColourSwatch, zimmColourSwatchGroup, or the new zimmGalleryOverlay test) actually assert on the circle variant's rendered styles/props, or just the square/default path? Check `zimmColourSwatchGroup/index.stories.tsx` too — does it have a story exercising `variant="circle"`?

Report format: one block per numbered item. file:line, what's wrong, CONFIRMED or PLAUSIBLE, severity (🔴/🟡/🔵), UNIFORM or ONE-OFF. End with "What I tried to falsify" and "What I could not verify" sections. State plainly anywhere you found the claim in the PR to hold up cleanly — a clean confirmation is a valid, useful finding too, don't only report problems.

## Item 1 — Is the circle-variant/appendColon work purely additive?

**Core additive claim: CONFIRMED CLEAN.**

- `ZimmColourSwatchGroup` (`.../molecules/zimmColourSwatchGroup/index.tsx:78,80`): `appendColon = true` default. `labelText = label != null ? (appendColon ? \`${label}:\` : label) : ...` reduces to base's `label != null ? \`${label}:\` : ...` exactly when `appendColon` is true. The new `{appendColon && selectedName && (...)}` guard (line 179) reduces to base's `{selectedName && (...)}` exactly under the same default. Confirmed via full diff — no other lines in this file's rendering logic changed except passing `variant` through to `ZimmColourSwatch` (line 247) and to `useMultiStyleConfig` (line 167).

**Real finding — the chevron `boxSize` addition is NOT additive; it's a genuine, unconditional change to already-shipped UI.**

- **Exact before/after:**
  - Base `zimmColourSwatchGroup/index.tsx:174`: `<ChevronLeftIcon aria-hidden />`
  - Base `zimmColourSwatchGroup/index.tsx:183`: `<ChevronRightIcon aria-hidden />`
  - Head `zimmColourSwatchGroup/index.tsx:193`: `<ChevronLeftIcon aria-hidden boxSize="var(--zimm-scale-m)" />`
  - Head `zimmColourSwatchGroup/index.tsx:202`: `<ChevronRightIcon aria-hidden boxSize="var(--zimm-scale-m)" />`
  - This sits directly in the shared JSX rendered for both variants — **not** gated behind `variant === 'circle'`.

- **Magnitude, traced (not guessed):** `ChevronLeftIcon`/`ChevronRightIcon` are `createIcon()`-built Chakra icons (`overrides/app/components/icons/zimm.tsx:108-118`). Chakra's own `Icon` component (`node_modules/@chakra-ui/icon/dist/icon.js`) calls `useStyleConfig('Icon', props)` and spreads the result **last**, i.e. it outranks the hardcoded `w:'1em',h:'1em'` default. `@salesforce/retail-react-app`'s base theme registers `Icon: { baseStyle: { boxSize: 6 } }` (`node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/theme/components/base/icon.js`). Zimmermann's `theme/components/index.ts` registers no `Icon` override, and `theme/index.ts` only overrides `theme.space`, not `theme.sizes` (confirmed by that file's own comment: "sizes  Chakra sizes.lg=32rem vs iconSizes.lg=20px" — i.e. deliberately untouched). Net: an unconditional ~33% shrink to the already-shipped, square-variant, main-PDP pagination chevrons.

- **Is it acknowledged?** Yes, in commit `8e0e50c`'s message: *"Reserved-width/gap math and pagination-chevron sizing in zimmColourSwatchGroup.css.ts made variant-aware **and corrected** against the Design System 2026 file's own 'ColourOptions' component (node 40001992:51882) — 4-per-page, 12px gap, **16px chevron icons in a 24px button**..."* — explicitly framed as a Figma-backed correction, not silent. It's also consistent with a comment that already existed **pre-PR** in `zimmColourSwatchGroup.css.ts`'s `pageButton` part (base lines 156–157): *"...with the 16px ZimmIcon centred inside it..."* — i.e. the 16px intent was already documented, just never wired into the JSX until now.

This looks like a stale PR description rather than concealment, but it means a reviewer relying on the PR body alone would have zero visibility into this change touching existing shipped UI.
